name: telegram-notify
description: Send notifications to Telegram from Claude Code - one bot, named targets, any scenario. Commands: /telegram-notify:setup (friendly one-time wizard: create the bot, then DISCOVER your chat id instead of hunting for it), :send (notify a target), :targets (add/list/remove named routes), :doctor (check the token and every target without spamming them). Named targets route different scenarios to different chats or forum topics: `tg.mjs send --to alerts --level error`. Node, zero deps, no MCP - so hooks and scripts can call it directly. Reads TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID / TELEGRAM_TARGETS from the environment or a 0600 config file.
